procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (73 numbered keys + 0 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-74 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates (the match rows carry labels 26-33 and are questions). Answer side 1-73; q74 (colour) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 47, average 4, difficult 18, untagged 5.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 24 (heading) 25 (LO, q1-15) 26-28; A pdf 129 (heading, keys 1-21) 130-133.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5 (heading untagged, stems untagged -> 5 x 'no difficulty tag'); s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '• Match the followings (easy)' q26-33; s5 one mark q34-43 vsa; s6 two marks q44-53 sa; s7 three marks q54-63 sa; s8 four marks q64-74 la.

MATCH ROWS: each column-A row prints its own question label (26-33) continuing the lesson's numbering, and the key side keys each row by the same label (pdf 130) -> each row is a question (v1.4 §14.1: ids are printed labels), type match with its one printed pair; stem = 'Match the followings: <row>' + column B as printed. Coordinator: this differs from evs-4-01/02 (one unlabelled-row match = one question) only because the rows here carry their own labels.
LO: 10 lines printed with '*' under 'Learning Out comes:-' (pdf 24-25).

Keys 54-73 print a heading on the number line ('Three stages of water cycle:') -> kept in answer.value, not a step (addendum §5.2). q66, q68, q70 end with an un-bulleted point ('Importance: …', 'Prevention: …') -> its own step.
q64 'Describe the water cycle. Draw its phases and label the parts.' — key is text only ('Draw and label: …'); stored verbatim + 'answer is a diagram' flag (no drawn key printed).
q74 figure -> stimulus st-evs-4-06-q74 (crop in images/evs-4-06/stimuli/, ruling D4); no key -> 'no answer printed'. T/F answer-space underscores removed from text.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_06.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
